detail.title: CP-UNR-4K4322-V4
features: Up to 32 channel IP camera input
Instastream, H.265, H.264 , H.264, MJPEG Decoding
Max. decoding capability: 8 × 1080p@30 fps or 2 × 8 MP@30 fps
Max. 160/128/60 Mbps Incoming/ Recording/ Outgoing Bandwidth
Support 2 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 2 USB Ports
AI by Camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter protection, SMD Plus,  People counting, Stereo analysis and heat map

General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera disconnection, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login locked, Cybersecurity exceptio
General.SMD Plus by NVR: 2 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 160 Mbps incoming, 128 Mbps recording and 60 Mbps outgoing  AI enabled: 80 Mbps incoming, 80 Mbps recording and 60 Mbps outgoing
General.Video Display Split: AI disabled: Main Screen: 1/4/8/9/16/25/36, Sub Screen: 1/4/8/9/16  AI enabled: Main Screen: 1/4/8/9/16, Sub Screen: 1/4/8/9/16
General.Hard Disk: 2 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperatur
General.Playback: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Interface Ports: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 2.0 port), 1 HDMI, 1 VGA
General.Protocols: HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP, DDNS,  SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Registration, ONVIF 22.12(Profile T, Profile S, Profile G),  CGI, SDK
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is <10 W(without HDD)
